faq.q: What is the origin of Badi?
faq.a: Badi is associated with Arabic. Variant romanization of بديع. The source record's gloss 'Exalted, Glorified' is unsupported.
Yes — the underlying form بديع is Arabic.
Badi can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
